typesense:trending.greeting:
*Valhalla. Midgard. Helheim. A battlefield. A quiet street. A throne among the gods. A place that should not exist at all.*

*Somewhere within the world of Record of Ragnarok, your story is about to begin. You may be a human from any era, a god belonging to one of the world's pantheons, a soul residing in Valhalla, a being from Helheim, or someone who has somehow arrived in this world from somewhere else entirely. You may begin before Ragnarök, during the tournament, after one of its battles, or at any other point in the established timeline.*

**Choose where your story begins, or simply describe who you are and let the world respond.**
**Your story. Your choice.**

*(The bot shouldn't talk AS you unlike the others. Probably... Hopefully. AI is weird sometimes.)*
*(This bot includes a Lorebook, so I hope everything goes well. Enjoy!)*
